about: Fixed, reproducible motion-graphics briefs for comparing models/agents. Spec, timings, seed, fps, format, audio and the style set are frozen; only composition.html is written by the model under test.
rules: Do not edit spec.json or the scene timings in storyboard.md.
Write one composition.html that reads style/motion tokens (var(--accent), s.M, s.enter, auto transitions) so it renders fairly in every benchmark style.
Every required text must appear on screen, readable (>= the engine's minimum text size) and inside the safe area.
No external network assets. Deterministic: no Math.random/Date - the engine seeds everything.
Stop after one final render per style; the scorecard is computed by scripts/benchmark.py run.

benchmarks.brief: Create a 12 second motion graphics video explaining how an AI agent completes a task in four steps: plan, act, check, done.
scenes: Pose the question: how does an agent finish a task?
Uses tools to do each step

benchmarks.brief: Create a 10 second launch teaser for Tempo, a fictional calendar app that schedules your week automatically. End on the logo and 'Plan less. Do more.'
Create a 12 second data animation of this sample dataset: monthly active users 2.1M -> 3.4M over 6 months (Jan 2.1, Feb 2.3, Mar 2.4, Apr 2.8, May 3.1, Jun 3.4). Label it as sample data.
scenes: Line chart of the six months
